findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: whats_new, get_harness, submit_app, subscribe_newsletter, get_sponsorship_info · Private data: get_app, list_agent_tools, get_harness, get_sponsorship_info · Public sink: submit_app, subscribe_newsletter, get_sponsorship_info · Destructive: subscribe_newsletter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: whats_new, get_harness, submit_app, subscribe_newsletter, get_sponsorship_info · Private data: get_app, list_agent_tools, get_harness, get_sponsorship_info · Public sink: submit_app, subscribe_newsletter, get_sponsorship_info · Destructive: subscribe_newsletter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
